newsitem.title: COMOROS: At least 25 survive crash of Ethiopian plane.
newsitem.headline: At least 25 survive crash of Ethiopian plane.

text.p: At least 25 of the up to 178 passengers and crew survived the crash of a hijacked Ethiopian Airlines Boeing 767 on Saturday, witnesses said.

Reuters correspondent Mohamed Kemardine said rescuers at a beachside hotel about 500 metres (yards) from where the plane plunged into the sea off the Comoro Islands told him there were at least 25 survivors.
The dead bodies retrieved so far were laid out in the conference room at the hotel.

"I saw 30 bodies...Mostly they are Asians and Africans. They were just covered with blankets," Kemardine said after visiting the scene, about 40 km (25 miles) north of Moroni, capital of the Indian Ocean archipelago.
